name: 150-ruling-15-nested-count-locator-beyond-item-bits
models:

version 0.1.0
distribution public
source "probe"
key uid string -
key type string -
key lat float deg
key lon float deg
key callsign string -

module probe
version 0.1.0
distribution public
source "probe"

pack:
